Submitted (status locked as **deviation**, preferred level, official checks and minimality gate all passing).

Final proposal:
1. **§16.2 (p0281)** — six-word insertion making consent "not to be unreasonably withheld" (mutual, covers IBM's consent standard for MSL assignments).
2. **§16.2 (insert after p0284)** — one concise sentence: IBM may assign without consent to an affiliate or successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, and MSL may not assign to any IBM competitor (absolute bar previously missing).
3. **§5.1(b)(v) (p0116)** — two-word narrowing so the competitor-acquisition trigger runs only on an MSL acquisition, removing MSL's exit right on an IBM change of control.

Removed all flagged extras ("Except as expressly provided below", "in whole or in part", the business-narrowing tail, and "in which case IBM may terminate"); MSL's existing consent requirement in §16.2 was mapped as already met.
